            // The header's 16-bit counts saturate; the full counts follow as ints
            // (Valve's dkr_onelevel world_physics: 132,490 objects, 65535 here).
            var objectCount = checked((int)(context.ObjectLengths.Length / sizeof(int)));
            var arrayCount = context.CountArrays;
            var countObjects = (ushort)Math.Min(objectCount, ushort.MaxValue);
            var countArrays = (ushort)Math.Min(arrayCount, ushort.MaxValue);
